derived_quantities.description: Higher of actual (billed) weight and the 25 kg minimum chargeable weight

charges.label: Freight on chargeable weight
charges.quote: consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight; consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight

charges.label: Fragile protected-handling charge
charges.quote: Consignments booked as fragile ... at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.

accessorials_policy.clause: alpine-express.md §1-§7 (no clause declares unlisted charges not payable)

invoice_adjustments.label: 5% volume discount on invoice total
invoice_adjustments.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

document_rules.rule: Carrier invoices monthly; payment due 30 days from invoice date.
Rate revisions require 60 days' written notice and take effect from the first day of the following calendar month.

ambiguities.description: Rate bands are 'under 50 kg' (9.50/kg) and 'over 50 kg' (8.25/kg); a consignment of exactly 50 kg chargeable weight falls in neither band, so its freight rate is undetermined.

notes: Express is not offered (§3); services_offered is ['standard']. Only fragile handling is priced (§4); cold_chain and residential have no contract charge. Contract does not declare a closed accessorial list. Bands in §2 applied to chargeable weight; applying them to actual weight gives identical results because the 25 kg minimum is below the 50 kg break.
